definitions.explanation: food served alongside a main dish to complement it, such as vegetables or salad

examples.japanese: ステーキの{付|つ}け{合|あ}わせは{何|なに}ですか。
{付|つ}け{合|あ}わせの{野菜|やさい}も{美味|おい}しかった。
examples.english: The vegetable side dish was also delicious.

examples.japanese: メインに{付|つ}け{合|あ}わせが{付|つ}いてくる。
examples.english: The main dish comes with a side.

notes:
USAGE:
- 〜の{付|つ}け{合|あ}わせ (the side dish for ~)
- {付|つ}け{合|あ}わせが{付|つ}く (comes with a side dish)
- {付|つ}け{合|あ}わせを{添|そ}える (to add a garnish)

COMMON EXAMPLES:
- ステーキの{付|つ}け{合|あ}わせ (steak sides: potatoes, corn, etc.)
- {刺身|さしみ}の{付|つ}け{合|あ}わせ ({大根|だいこん}のつま, {紫蘇|しそ})
- ハンバーグの{付|つ}け{合|あ}わせ (hamburger sides)

WESTERN vs JAPANESE:
- Western: often potatoes, vegetables, salad
- Japanese: often pickles, small salads, {漬物|つけもの}

RELATED:
- おかず (side dish - broader term)
- {添|そ}え{物|もの} (garnish, accompaniment)
- サイドメニュー (side menu)
- {薬味|やくみ} (condiment, garnish for flavor)
